title: Raycast configuration
description: Actions consumed by configureFile and the configure CLI; runtime validation additionally rejects duplicate command IDs

$schema.description: Editor schema association; ignored at runtime

fallbackUser.description: Used when no stored profile exists

currentUserPatch.description: Fields applied over the stored profile or fallbackUser

currentUser.description: Stored as a replacement profile; extra fields are preserved and local OAuth defaults are cleared

avatarFile.description: Path relative to this config file; takes precedence over avatarUrl

avatarUrl.description: Avatar URL used when avatarFile is absent

appAliases.description: Resolve application command IDs from the local Raycast index; unmatched entries without a fallback path are skipped

id.description: Command ID; must be unique within commandAliases

alias.description: No whitespace; null or an empty string removes the alias

enabled.description: Omit to preserve the existing value, or default to true for a new command

commandAliases.description: Only listed commands are changed; command IDs must be unique

themesFile.description: Theme JSON path relative to this config file

disableAi.description: True applies the AI-disable policy; false leaves settings unchanged

launch.description: True opens Raycast after requested actions
